topic_label: Commitment to integrity and ethical values
control_description: Owner's direct oversight: POL-01 states the shop's commitments to customers. Gap: the intake form promised "We never access your personal data" and the website claimed "military standard" wiping, neither true
gap: Customer-facing statements did not match practice (P03 G-107, G-108)
remediation: Rewrite the intake notice; remove the wiping claim

control_description: Not applicable: a sole proprietorship has no board of directors. Oversight is the owner's own annual review (POL-01 4.5), with an outside reviewer at least every second year
Owner's direct oversight: the owner holds every role, designated in writing in POL-01 4.2
Owner is a skilled technician but has no security training; the fill-in technician has never been briefed
Owner is accountable for every control. Gap: no agreement holds the fill-in technician accountable
SYS-01, email, and the processor portal record activity, but nobody reviews it

topic_label: Internal communication of objectives and responsibilities
control_description: The only other person who works in the shop is the fill-in technician, who has never been told the rules
gap: Rules not communicated to the contractor

control_description: Customers get an intake form and status texts; no channel for security questions or breach notice; processor notice term unknown until P03
remediation: New intake notice; P08 contacts and customer warning template

topic_label: Objectives specified to enable risk identification
control_description: Objectives set in the BIA and the risk framing in P01
15 risks identified and rated with SP 800-30
Fraud considered: fake payment texts after an account takeover (R-001), terminal skimming (R-007), and fake supplier invoices (R-015)
New tools (AI assistant, camera service) were adopted without any risk check
First self-assessment done in July 2026; no ongoing checks
remediation: Monthly review plus annual July self-assessment

control_description: Owner's direct oversight: deficiencies go straight to the POA&M and the owner fixes them

topic_label: Control activities selected to mitigate risk
control_description: Controls selected in P02 against the P01 risks; many still planned
SaaS technology controls inherited from vendors; the bench PC and router have no baseline settings

topic_label: Control activities deployed through policies and procedures
control_description: POL-01 adopted 2026-08-31; sanitization and deletion procedures still being written

topic_label: Logical access security software, infrastructure, architecture
control_description: MFA on the suite, accounting, bank, and processor portal. Gaps: shared SYS-01 login without MFA; bench PC with no password and no encryption
gap: Weak logical access where customer data is

control_description: No registration of the fill-in technician; access is by the owner's password
One administrator role for everyone; a stale session on the fill-in technician's phone
Locked, alarmed storefront; devices and the terminal in a locked cabinet overnight
Drop-off devices and transfer drives leave or are reused without sanitization records; customer copies never deleted
remediation: SP 800-88 Rev. 2 procedure and 14-day deletion (POAM-003, POAM-006)

topic_label: Protection against threats from outside boundaries
control_description: Router blocks inbound connections; customer devices share the internal network

topic_label: Restriction of data transmission and movement
control_description: Card data encrypted by P2PE and SaaS traffic by TLS. Gaps: customer data on unencrypted transfer drives; ticket notes pasted into a consumer AI tool; card numbers on paper
remediation: Encrypted drives; AI rules (POL-01 9.7); card rule (8.8)

topic_label: Prevention and detection of unauthorized or malicious software
control_description: Built-in antivirus on the laptop and bench PC. Gaps: forum-sourced tools; autoplay on for USB devices; no software restriction
remediation: Approved tool list and standard account (POL-01 9.2, 9.3)

topic_label: Detection of configuration changes and vulnerabilities
control_description: Automatic updates on all computers and mobile devices; router firmware and settings never checked

topic_label: Monitoring for anomalies and security events
control_description: No monitoring; SYS-01 sign-in alerts filtered into an unread folder
remediation: Alerts to the phone; monthly review

control_description: No criteria for deciding whether an event is an incident at the time of the check
No incident plan at the time of the check (P08 adopted 2026-08-31)
BIA recovery order exists; no recovery steps written

Not applicable: the shop develops no software and runs no infrastructure; the ticketing vendor's change management is inherited (its SOC 2 report, Part B). Owner setting changes are logged under POL-01 5.4
BIA done; the single-person dependency has no fallback yet
gap: No emergency access or device-return procedure
